evals.name: memory-doesnt-sync-itself
evals.prompt: Is everything in this Wheelhouse shared properly?
evals.evidence: git status --short --untracked-files=all | grep -v "^?? .beads/" ; echo; echo "$ cat .ynm/config.json"; cat .ynm/config.json; echo; echo "$ git log --oneline"; git log --oneline
evals.expected_output: Runs the check. The Wheelhouse is set up right, pushed, and its work graph shares through origin with auto-push on, but ynm's sync.auto is off, so memory written mid-session waits for a git push, a seat's wake or its session end, which a crash skips. Reports that as a warning, with the fix: add sync with auto true (and an interval) to .ynm/config.json and commit it, which needs ynm 0.5.0. Asks before changing it.
assertions: The reply says memory doesn't sync itself: ynm's sync.auto is off (or there is no sync block), so memory waits for a push, a wake or a session end
The reply gives the fix: a sync block with auto true in .ynm/config.json, committed
Nothing was changed: the evidence shows .ynm/config.json still without a sync block, and the reply doesn't say it changed it
The reply says the work graph is shared and the rest of the Wheelhouse is set up right
